floating_accumulation_tolerances.purpose: Local floating accumulation checks only; these tolerances do not replace the frozen scientific screening thresholds.

actual_checks.normalization: absolute difference / max(1, absolute reported metric)

primary_result.qualification: Preserved is worse on all four MAE weightings; shuffled is better on two and worse on two. Preserved has slightly better pooled RMSE/P99 than linear, so not all metrics deteriorate.

preserved_vs_linear_error_accounting.interpretation: Disjoint descriptive output-error accounting, not causal shares of training mechanisms. Negative additional harm or lost improvement denotes improvement in that respective quantity.

exploratory_scene_sensitivity.scope: Post-result descriptive sensitivity only; does not alter the complete-population result, frozen screen, model choice or evaluation population.

preserved_vs_linear_mae.exclude_top_10_rule: For each scene compute (preserved point MAE - linear point MAE) * covered points; sort descending and exclude the first ten. Recompute the point-weighted MAE difference over all remaining scene rows.
preserved_vs_linear_mae.interpretation: The complete-population MAE degradation is not driven only by the largest adverse scene or the ten largest adverse scene contributions.

preserved_vs_linear_sse.interpretation: The small pooled RMSE advantage is sensitive to scene3035: that scene contributes114.04% of the net SSE reduction, and the RMSE direction reverses after excluding it. A share above100% reflects offsetting deterioration elsewhere; it is not causal attribution. No analogous leave-one-scene-out P99 was computed without raw point arrays.

sampled_training_window_description.method: Arithmetic mean of equal100-successful-update window means, using the paired original batches.
sampled_training_window_description.interpretation: Preserved has slightly lower sampled training loss but worse V MAE. Different windows contain different random batches; these are not fixed-probe convergence curves and do not locate or prove overfitting, convergence or a benefit from extra training.

returned_execution_evidence.local_provenance_limit: These execution and parameter checks are returned server evidence inspected against the contract, not locally repeated checkpoint/JSONL/NPZ proofs.

interpretation_boundaries: Same-capacity A/B arms cannot identify extra parameter count as the cause of their difference.
Routing changes in both training and evaluation; this experiment does not isolate the causal effect of either stage alone.
Nonzero branch gradients establish participation in optimization, not successful identity or reliability learning.
A single failed recipe does not establish that temporal correspondence is universally useless or never used by the network.
087 preserves complete input and physical priors; its predominantly additional-harm failure should not be equated with083's deletion intervention or089's T-prior changes.
Repeated V use, shared identities and one training seed limit generalization claims; 38 components are not independent training replications.
The favorable multi-helper opportunity cell is post-result descriptive evidence and does not override the failed predeclared strong-baseline screen.
